description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadFilter, which provides methods related to loading and checking filters in the Smarty templating system. It includes functionality to load filters of various types (pre, post, output, variable) and verify filter types, handling plugin loading and exception throwing.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_LoadFilter
classes.description: Class providing internal methods to load and validate filters within the Smarty templating system.

methods.name: loadFilter
methods.description: Loads a filter of the specified type and name, registering it within Smarty if callable or loaded successfully.

methods.name: _checkFilterType
methods.description: Checks whether the provided filter type is valid; throws exception if invalid.
